polypop.connected.description: Runs when the PolyPop WebSocket plugin connects to Cuebot. Cuebot opens the door; PolyPop comes in.

variables.polypop.remote: Where the PolyPop plugin connected from

polypop.disconnected.description: Runs when the last PolyPop plugin connection closes.

variables.polypop.remote: Where the PolyPop plugin connected from

polypop.message.description: Runs when PolyPop sends Cuebot a message through its WebSocket plugin, for example when a button or trigger in PolyPop is pressed.

fields.type: Only react to this kind of message, like "TRIGGER". Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any kind.
fields.name: Only react to messages with this name (the name set on the PolyPop side). Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any name.

variables.polypop.type: The kind of message, like TRIGGER
variables.polypop.name: The name PolyPop gave the message
variables.polypop.data: Extra information that came with it
variables.polypop.raw: The whole message exactly as received

polypop.triggerAlert.description: Makes PolyPop play a WebSocket Alert, with values you choose. Handy for on-screen alerts and effects.

fields.alertName: The name of the alert you made in PolyPop's WebSocket source, exactly as you typed it there.
fields.variables: Values to pass into the alert, one per line as name=value, like "user=%user%". Each name appears in PolyPop as <name>. Leave empty for none.

variables.polypopClients: How many PolyPop plugins received the alert
